verses.original: Ἔπειτα διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν πάλιν ἀνέβην εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα μετὰ Βαρνάβα συμπαραλαβὼν καὶ Τίτον
verses.transliteration: Epeita dia dekatessarōn etōn palin anebēn eis Hierosolyma meta Barnaba symparalabōn kai Titon
verses.literal: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem accompanied by Barnabas I took Titus along also
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS, passados catorze anos, subi outra vez a Jerusalém com Barnabé, levando também comigo Tito.

verses.original: ἀνέβην δὲ κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν καὶ ἀνεθέμην αὐτοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ κηρύσσω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν κατ’ ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς δοκοῦσιν μή πως εἰς κενὸν τρέχω ἢ ἔδραμον
verses.transliteration: anebēn de kata apokalypsin kai anethemēn autois to euangelion ho kēryssō en tois ethnesin kat’ idian de tois dokousin mē pōs eis kenon trechō ē edramon
verses.literal: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles But I spoke privately to those recognized as leaders for fear that I was running or had already run in vain
verses.literalPt: E subi por uma revelação, e lhes expus o evangelho, que prego entre os gentios, e particularmente aos que estavam em estima; para que de maneira alguma não corresse ou não tivesse corrido em vão.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Τίτος ὁ σὺν ἐμοί Ἕλλην ὤν ἠναγκάσθη περιτμηθῆναι
verses.transliteration: all’ oude Titos ho syn emoi Hellēn ōn ēnankasthē peritmēthēnai
verses.literal: Yet not even Titus who was with me was compelled to be circumcised even though he was a Greek
verses.literalPt: Mas nem ainda Tito, que estava comigo, sendo grego, foi constrangido a circuncidar-se;

verses.original: διὰ δὲ τοὺς παρεισάκτους ψευδαδέλφους οἵτινες παρεισῆλθον κατασκοπῆσαι τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ἡμῶν ἣν ἔχομεν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα ἡμᾶς καταδουλώσουσιν
verses.transliteration: dia de tous pareisaktous pseudadelphous hoitines pareisēlthon kataskopēsai tēn eleutherian hēmōn hēn echomen en Christō Iēsou hina hēmas katadoulōsousin
verses.literal: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom - in Christ Jesus in order to enslave us
verses.literalPt: E isto por causa dos falsos irmãos que se intrometeram, e secretamente entraram a espiar a nossa liberdade, que temos em Cristo Jesus, para nos porem em servidão;

verses.original: οἷς οὐδὲ πρὸς ὥραν εἴξαμεν τῇ ὑποταγῇ ἵνα ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐαγγελίου διαμείνῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hois oude pros hōran eixamen tē hypotagē hina hē alētheia tou euangeliou diameinē pros hymas
verses.literal: We did not give in . . . . . . to them for a moment so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you
verses.literalPt: Aos quais nem ainda por uma hora cedemos com sujeição, para que a verdade do evangelho permanecesse entre vós.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν δοκούντων εἶναί τι ὁποῖοί ποτε ἦσαν οὐδέν μοι διαφέρει πρόσωπον ὁ Θεὸς ἀνθρώπου οὐ λαμβάνει ἐμοὶ γὰρ οἱ δοκοῦντες οὐδὲν προσανέθεντο
verses.transliteration: Apo de tōn dokountōn einai ti hopoioi pote ēsan ouden moi diapherei prosōpon ho Theos anthrōpou ou lambanei emoi gar hoi dokountes ouden prosanethento
verses.literal: But as for the highly esteemed . . . . . . whatever they were . . . makes no difference to me God does not show favoritism . . . . . . . . . those leaders added nothing to me
verses.literalPt: E, quanto àqueles que pareciam ser alguma coisa (quais tenham sido noutro tempo, não se me dá; Deus não aceita a aparência do homem), esses, digo, que pareciam ser alguma coisa, nada me comunicaram;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοὐναντίον ἰδόντες ὅτι πεπίστευμαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἀκροβυστίας καθὼς Πέτρος τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: alla tounantion idontes hoti pepisteumai to euangelion tēs akrobystias kathōs Petros tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: On the contrary they saw that I had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised just as Peter had been to the circumcised
verses.literalPt: Antes, pelo contrário, quando viram que o evangelho da incircuncisão me estava confiado, como a Pedro o da circuncisão

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἐνεργήσας Πέτρῳ εἰς ἀποστολὴν τῆς περιτομῆς ἐνήργησεν καὶ ἐμοὶ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: ho gar energēsas Petrō eis apostolēn tēs peritomēs enērgēsen kai emoi eis ta ethnē
verses.literal: For the One who was at work in Peter’s . . . apostleship to the circumcised was also at work . . . in my apostleship to the Gentiles
verses.literalPt: (Porque aquele que operou eficazmente em Pedro para o apostolado da circuncisão, esse operou também em mim com eficácia para com os gentios),

verses.original: καὶ γνόντες τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι Ἰάκωβος καὶ Κηφᾶς καὶ Ἰωάννης οἱ δοκοῦντες στῦλοι εἶναι δεξιὰς ἔδωκαν ἐμοὶ καὶ Βαρνάβα κοινωνίας ἵνα ἡμεῖς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς τὴν περιτομήν
verses.transliteration: kai gnontes tēn charin tēn dotheisan moi Iakōbos kai Kēphas kai Iōannēs hoi dokountes styloi einai dexias edōkan emoi kai Barnaba koinōnias hina hēmeis eis ta ethnē autoi de eis tēn peritomēn
verses.literal: And recognizing the grace that I had been given James Cephas and John those reputed to be pillars gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship so that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised
verses.literalPt: E conhecendo Tiago, Cefas e João, que eram considerados como as colunas, a graça que me havia sido dada, deram-nos as destras, em comunhão comigo e com Barnabé, para que nós fôssemos aos gentios, e eles à circuncisão;

verses.original: μόνον τῶν πτωχῶν ἵνα μνημονεύωμεν ὃ καὶ ἐσπούδασα αὐτὸ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: monon tōn ptōchōn hina mnēmoneuōmen ho kai espoudasa auto touto poiēsai
verses.literal: They only asked us to remember the poor the very thing - I was eager to do
verses.literalPt: Recomendando-nos somente que nos lembrássemos dos pobres, o que também procurei fazer com diligência.

verses.original: Ὅτε δὲ ἦλθεν Κηφᾶς εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῷ ἀντέστην ὅτι κατεγνωσμένος ἦν
verses.transliteration: Hote de ēlthen Kēphas eis Antiocheian kata prosōpon autō antestēn hoti kategnōsmenos ēn
verses.literal: When Cephas came to Antioch however I opposed him to his face because he stood condemned
verses.literalPt: E, chegando Pedro à Antioquia, lhe resisti na cara, porque era repreensível.

verses.original: πρὸ τοῦ γὰρ ἐλθεῖν τινας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβου μετὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν συνήσθιεν ὅτε δὲ ἦλθον ὑπέστελλεν καὶ ἀφώριζεν ἑαυτόν φοβούμενος τοὺς ἐκ περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: pro tou gar elthein tinas apo Iakōbou meta tōn ethnōn synēsthien hote de ēlthon hypestellen kai aphōrizen heauton phoboumenos tous ek peritomēs
verses.literal: For before certain men came from James he used to eat with the Gentiles But when they arrived he began to draw back and separate himself for fear of those in the circumcision group
verses.literalPt: Porque, antes que alguns tivessem chegado da parte de Tiago, comia com os gentios; mas, depois que chegaram, se foi retirando, e se apartou deles, temendo os que eram da circuncisão.

verses.original: καὶ συνυπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ Ἰουδαῖοι ὥστε καὶ Βαρνάβας συναπήχθη αὐτῶν τῇ ὑποκρίσει
verses.transliteration: kai synypekrithēsan autō kai hoi loipoi Ioudaioi hōste kai Barnabas synapēchthē autōn tē hypokrisei
verses.literal: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy . . . so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray
verses.literalPt: E os outros judeus também dissimulavam com ele, de maneira que até Barnabé se deixou levar pela sua dissimulação.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ὅτε εἶδον ὅτι οὐκ ὀρθοποδοῦσιν πρὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου εἶπον τῷ Κηφᾷ ἔμπροσθεν πάντων Εἰ σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὑπάρχων ἐθνικῶς καὶ οὐκ Ἰουδαϊκῶς ζῇς πῶς τὰ ἔθνη ἀναγκάζεις ἰουδαΐζειν
verses.transliteration: All’ hote eidon hoti ouk orthopodousin pros tēn alētheian tou euangeliou eipon tō Kēpha emprosthen pantōn Ei sy Ioudaios hyparchōn ethnikōs kai ouk Ioudaikōs zēs pōs ta ethnē anankazeis ioudaizein
verses.literal: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel I said to Cephas in front of them all If you who are a Jew live like a Gentile and not like a Jew how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando vi que não andavam bem e direitamente conforme a verdade do evangelho, disse a Pedro na presença de todos: Se tu, sendo judeu, vives como os gentios, e não como judeu, por que obrigas os gentios a viverem como judeus?

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς φύσει Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἐθνῶν Ἁμαρτωλοί
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis physei Ioudaioi kai ouk ex ethnōn Hamartōloi
verses.literal: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile sinners
verses.literalPt: Nós somos judeus por natureza, e não pecadores dentre os gentios.

verses.original: εἰδότες δὲ ὅτι οὐ δικαιοῦται ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἐὰν μὴ διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐπιστεύσαμεν ἵνα δικαιωθῶμεν ἐκ πίστεως Χριστοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ δικαιωθήσεται πᾶσα σάρξ
verses.transliteration: eidotes de hoti ou dikaioutai anthrōpos ex ergōn nomou ean mē dia pisteōs Christou Iēsou kai hēmeis eis Christon Iēsoun episteusamen hina dikaiōthōmen ek pisteōs Christou kai ouk ex ergōn nomou hoti ex ergōn nomou ou dikaiōthēsetai pasa sarx
verses.literal: know that a man is not justified by works of the law but . . . by faith in Jesus Christ So we, too . . . have believed in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law because by works of the law no one . . . . . . will be justified
verses.literalPt: Sabendo que o homem não é justificado pelas obras da lei, mas pela fé em Jesus Cristo, temos também crido em Jesus Cristo, para sermos justificados pela fé em Cristo, e não pelas obras da lei; porquanto pelas obras da lei nenhuma carne será justificada.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ζητοῦντες δικαιωθῆναι ἐν Χριστῷ εὑρέθημεν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἁμαρτωλοί ἆρα Χριστὸς ἁμαρτίας διάκονος μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ei de zētountes dikaiōthēnai en Christō heurethēmen kai autoi hamartōloi ara Christos hamartias diakonos mē genoito
verses.literal: But if while we seek to be justified in Christ we ourselves . . . are found to be sinners does that make Christ a minister of sin Certainly not
verses.literalPt: Pois, se nós, que procuramos ser justificados em Cristo, nós mesmos também somos achados pecadores, é porventura Cristo ministro do pecado? De maneira nenhuma.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἃ κατέλυσα ταῦτα πάλιν οἰκοδομῶ παραβάτην ἐμαυτὸν συνιστάνω
verses.transliteration: ei gar ha katelysa tauta palin oikodomō parabatēn emauton synistanō
verses.literal: If I rebuild . . . what I have already torn down I prove myself to be a lawbreaker
verses.literalPt: Porque, se torno a edificar aquilo que destruí, constituo-me a mim mesmo transgressor.

verses.original: ἐγὼ γὰρ διὰ νόμου νόμῳ ἀπέθανον ἵνα Θεῷ ζήσω
verses.transliteration: egō gar dia nomou nomō apethanon hina Theō zēsō
verses.literal: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God
verses.literalPt: Porque eu, pela lei, estou morto para a lei, para viver para Deus.

verses.original: Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι ζῶ δὲ οὐκέτι ἐγώ ζῇ δὲ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί ἐν πίστει ζῶ τῇ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντός με καὶ παραδόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Christō synestaurōmai zō de ouketi egō zē de en emoi Christos ho de nyn zō en sarki en pistei zō tē tou Huiou tou Theou tou agapēsantos me kai paradontos heauton hyper emou
verses.literal: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live but Christ lives in me The life I live in the body I live by faith in the Son of God who loved me and gave Himself up . . . for me
verses.literalPt: Já estou crucificado com Cristo; e vivo, não mais eu, mas Cristo vive em mim; e a vida que agora vivo na carne, vivo-a na fé do Filho de Deus, o qual me amou, e se entregou a si mesmo por mim.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἀθετῶ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰ γὰρ διὰ νόμου δικαιοσύνη ἄρα Χριστὸς δωρεὰν ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: Ouk athetō tēn charin tou Theou ei gar dia nomou dikaiosynē ara Christos dōrean apethanen
verses.literal: I do not set aside the grace of God For if righteousness comes through the law then Christ died for nothing
verses.literalPt: Não aniquilo a graça de Deus; porque, se a justiça provém da lei, segue-se que Cristo morreu debalde.
